summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the new Guided Builder (Story Studio) at /builder via Playwright on the public preview URL. Verified: page/primer/tree render, 3-level progressive drill-down (group -> classification -> heading), plot-point result cards with ZERO Plotto #reference leakage, seeding into Stepping View, Story Past (parent-option-N) / Story Future (child-option-N) ordinal cards with no #ids, append via child click, prepend via parent click, 'becomes ...' character-change note on options and 'character change · becomes ...' on spine nodes, past-beginning note (conflict 259) and future-ending note (conflict 94a), spine up/down/remove controls, Process Steps drawer (cast + plain-English steps + conclusion badge), sign-in prompt when anonymous, full login -> build -> name -> folder -> save -> visible in My Library under TEST_QA Folder. Reference pages: /conflict/1108 renders bare 'SN' as a green character chip (rgb(5,150,105) on terra/10 bg) and key entry 'SN = A son'; /conflict/844b shows the 'YOU MIGHT ALSO JUMP TO' suggested-connections section (2 items) and suggested-link-94b navigates correctly. Core requested flow works end to end; only minor issues found.

minor.issue: Summary text is truncated/dangling: 'A, when B, the woman he loves, refuses to marry him, becomes' — sentence ends mid-clause (likely the trailing transformation symbol was dropped during summary generation). Renders as an incomplete plot-point card in the guided results list.
Test user writer@plotto.app did not exist in the current DB (login returned 401 'Invalid email or password'); had to register it. Seed/document the writer test user so QA credentials stay valid.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec says the box should show 3-5 matching plot-points; it renders every conflict in the heading (limit 60) — observed 36 and 42 cards, requiring long scrolling and diluting the 'pick one of a handful' UX.

Character-change gloss is not fully translated: shows 'becomes male rival or enemy of A' / 'character change — now male rival or enemy of A' while the cast list correctly expands it to 'Male rival or enemy of male protagonist'. Raw symbol 'A' still leaks into the plain-English note.

integration_issues.issue: Save persisted correctly (plot appears in My Library under TEST_QA Folder, 3 conflicts) but the success toast was no longer in the DOM ~4.5s after click, so toast text could not be asserted. Likely just sonner auto-dismiss timing, not a defect — noting for the next agent.

action_items: Decide/limit the number of plot-point cards shown per heading (spec: 3-5, e.g. sample/paginate) instead of all 36-60
Fix roleLabel/transformNotes so glosses recursively expand embedded symbols (e.g. 'male rival or enemy of the male protagonist' instead of '... of A')
Repair or filter the truncated conflict summary for id 259 ('...becomes') in plotto_store data pipeline
Seed the writer@plotto.app test user (or update /app/memory/test_credentials.md) — it was missing and had to be registered by QA
critical_code_review_comments: GuidedBuilder passes limit=60 to /plotto/conflicts and renders all items; the guided UX contract calls for a small curated set — cap or sample server-side.

roleLabel() returns the raw character description verbatim, so nested symbols in descriptions ('male rival or enemy of A') are never expanded; reuse the resolveCast/renderPlainEnglish expansion for glosses to keep number-free/plain-English consistency.
DrillDownTree keeps its own expand state independent of the builder reset; after 'New' the previously selected heading's results remain on canvas which is acceptable but worth confirming as intended.
seed_data_creation: Registered test user writer@plotto.app / writer123 (QA Writer) via /api/auth/register (captcha math). Saved plot 'TEST_QA Guided Story' in folder 'TEST_QA Folder' (3 conflicts) under that user — left in place for main agent verification.
test_credentials: writer@plotto.app / writer123 (created during this run); admin@plotto.app / PlottoAdmin123 (untested this run)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All guided-flow testids verified working: tree-group-<Category>, tree-sub-<name> (note curly apostrophe in 'Love’s Beginning'), tree-heading-<name>, plot-point-N, stepping-view, spine-count, spine-node-N, parent-option-N, child-option-N, past-beginning, future-ending, spine-up/down/remove-N, process-steps-button, process-steps-review, review-cast, review-step-N, review-signin-button, review-title-input, review-folder-input, review-save-button, suggested-connections, suggested-link-<id>. Useful fixtures: conflict 1e = plot-point-4 of Love and Courtship > Love’s Beginning > 'Being Impelled...' (child options carry 'change A to A-3' -> becomes note); conflict 259 = plot-point-5 of Love’s Rejection > 'Following a Wrong Course through Mistaken Judgment' (zero lead-ups -> past-beginning); conflict 94a = plot-point-39 of Love’s Misadventures > 'Being Impelled...' (zero carry-ons -> future-ending). Reload the page after clicking new-story-button before re-driving the tree, otherwise a second click on the same group collapses it. Library folder headings are rendered uppercase via CSS, so match case-insensitively.
rca_of_the_issue: No blocking defect. The 'becomes ... of A' leak stems from plottoText.roleLabel returning the character description as-is (descriptions themselves contain symbols); the truncated #259 card originates in backend summary data, not the UI.
